cells.motion: vibrates with joy, jumps up and down, claps

guidelines.sheet: 1x1 sticker sheet, 1 separate characters, equal cells, wide gaps between characters, no character touches its cell edge
guidelines.style: flat vector sticker illustration, bold clean shapes, vibrant colors, friendly proportions
guidelines.background: flat pure green (#00FF00) background, no shadows, no floor, no gradients
guidelines.consistency: same character design, proportions and colors in all 1 cells
guidelines.motion: each character moves in place, no interaction between cells, static camera, seamless loop

sheet_prompt:
A single character, centred on a square canvas.
Subject: superman.
Style: flat vector illustration, bold clean shapes, solid vibrant colours, friendly proportions.
Outline: none. Draw the character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Expression and state of action (a wide range of emotions, a clear body position), big and readable at small size: bursting with excitement, star-sparkle eyes, fists shaking
Background: one single flat pure green (#00FF00) colour over the entire image, one identical shade everywhere; no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Margin: full body, centred, with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of the canvas), nothing touching or crossing the edge.
video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. vibrates with joy, jumps up and down, claps
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 1x1 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.

stickers.prompt: superman bursting with excitement, star-sparkle eyes, fists shaking, full body, centred, generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of the cell), nothing touching or crossing the cell edge
